text_block_list.text:
Summer is here, and with it comes the
academy's
large-scale group training
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a member of the student council, Air
Groove
has her work cut out for her
taking care of the
rowdy and excited
younger students.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she doesn't intend to use that
as an
excuse to slack off on training for
the Shuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
